[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T22:02:14Z, by staff] SL Green Realty Corp. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises 2026 FFO Outlook
SL Green Realty Corp. announced its Q3 2026 financial results, reporting net income of $72.2 million and FFO of $1.59 per share, while raising its full-year 2026 FFO guidance.
SL Green Realty Corp. reported net income attributable to common stockholders of $72.2 million, or $1.01 per share, for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $24.9 million, or $0.34 per share, in the same period of 2025. The company also reported quarterly revenue of $273.0 million. Alongside these results, SL Green raised its full-year 2026 Funds From Operations (FFO) outlook to a range of $6.50 to $6.70 per share. These figures reflect the company's performance as New York City's largest owner of commercial office properties.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T22:02:06Z, by staff] Wyndham Hotels & Resorts Reports Q3 Results and Raises Full-Year 2026 Outlook
Wyndham Hotels & Resorts reported a 6% year-over-year increase in U.S. RevPAR for the third quarter and raised its full-year 2026 guidance for RevPAR, adjusted EBITDA, and EPS, while also increasing its share repurchase authorization by $400 million.
Wyndham Hotels & Resorts announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting a 6% year-over-year growth in U.S. RevPAR. Following these results, the company raised its full-year 2026 outlook for RevPAR, adjusted EBITDA, and earnings per share. Additionally, the board of directors authorized an increase of $400 million to the company's share repurchase program. The company reported $100 million in free cash flow for the quarter and noted that its development pipeline includes approximately 264,000 rooms across more than 2,200 hotels.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T22:01:48Z, by staff] CACI International Inc Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Results and Raises Guidance
CACI International Inc announced its fiscal first quarter 2027 financial results, reporting $2.5 billion in revenue and raising its full-year outlook for revenue, adjusted net income, and adjusted EPS.
CACI International Inc reported revenue of $2.5 billion for the fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2026, representing an 8.2% increase year-over-year. The company achieved net income of $130.4 million and adjusted net income of $171.0 million, with adjusted diluted EPS rising 11.8% to $7.66. CACI also reported strong operational performance, including $4.8 billion in contract awards and a 2.0x book-to-bill ratio. Driven by these results and a healthy pipeline, management raised its fiscal year 2027 guidance for revenue, adjusted net income, and adjusted EPS. CEO John Mengucci attributed the performance to the company's mission proximity, software-defined approach, and ability to invest ahead of customer needs.
